sn47.22:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā bhaddo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
sn47.22:1.3: ko nu kho āvuso ānanda hetu ko paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hoti.
sn47.22:1.4: ko panāvuso ānanda hetu ko paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hotīti.
sn47.22:2.2: bhaddako kho te āvuso bhadda ummaggo bhaddakaṃ paṭibhāṇaṃ kalyāṇī paripucchā.
sn47.22:2.4: ko nu kho āvuso ānanda hetu ko paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hoti.
sn47.22:2.5: ko panāvuso ānanda hetu ko paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hotīti.
sn47.22:2.7: catunnaṃ kho āvuso satipaṭṭhānānaṃ abhāvitattā abahulī katattā tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hoti.
sn47.22:2.8: catunnaṃ ca kho āvuso satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hoti.
sn47.22:3.2: idhāvuso bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.22:3.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.22:3.6: imesaṃ kho āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hoti.
sn47.22:3.7: imesaṃ ca kho āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hotīti.
